headline_hook: Claude Fable Ships sqlite-utils for $149 While Alibaba Bans Claude Code
preview_topics: AI tutoring that rivals human teachers

pick_of_the_day.thesis: The $149 price tag isn't a parlor trick — it's the first credible, auditable data point for AI-as-primary-author in serious open-source infrastructure, and it forces every maintainer to recalculate the economics of library development.

model_literacy.relevance: The sqlite-utils rewrite shows how modern coding agents decompose multi-thousand-line library rewrites into sequential, verifiable steps — not one giant generation pass, but an iterative plan-write-test-fix loop that mirrors how experienced developers actually ship at scale.

items.title: Simon Willison's sqlite-utils 4.0 Was Mostly Written by Claude Fable — for $149
items.angle: A credible developer publicly audits the cost and quality of letting an AI agent write an entire library release — real numbers builders can benchmark against
items.key_fact: $149.25 total cost for Claude Fable to write most of sqlite-utils 4.0rc2
